items.title: 68252_Jay Cee
items.q: Porter Granger introduced me to her. He said there was somebody I wanted you to meet, and so he introduced me to Bessie.

ctx.x: Uh huh. Did you ever write for certain people? In other words, did somebody stimulate your creativity in that respect, you know; say, oh, well -- Bessie Smith -- did you know Bessie Smith before you wrote "Empty Bed Blues"?

Yes, yes, I did -- I knew Bessie Smith before that because of the fact that Porter Granger introduced me to her. He said there was somebody I wanted you to meet, and so he introduced me to Bessie. And it wasn't very long after that that I wrote "Empty Bed Blues."
Do you know what Herbie Harper told me?
